title: [inductor][NVGEMM] Share CuTeDSL epilogue lowering with FlexGEMM
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* #191515

Extract the FlexGEMM CuTeDSL expression emitter into shared GEMM epilogue
infrastructure, then add a frontend that lowers NVGEMM scheduler loop-body IR
through the same op overrides. Block-scaled NVGEMM providers can now execute
the generated CuTeDSL epilogue directly instead of translating it through
CUTLASS EVT.

Keep dense NVGEMM on EVT because its current vendored provider consumes the EVT
DAG as part of construction. Unsupported direct-lowering operations also fall
back to EVT, preserving the existing support surface while the provider
boundary is migrated incrementally.

Test Plan:

```text
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1 python test/inductor/test_nv_universal_gemm.py TestNVUniversalGemmEpilogueFusion.test_scaled_mm_pointwise_epilogue_fusion_operation_sigmoid TestNVUniversalGemmEpilogueFusion.test_scaled_mm_multi_store_epilogue_fusion TestNVUniversalGemmEpilogueFusion.test_matmul_multi_store_epilogue_fusion -v
python test/inductor/test_flex_gemm.py -v
python test/inductor/test_cutedsl_template.py -v
lintrunner -a
```

Authored with an AI assistant.

<!-- ai-review-bot -->
## AI-Review

> *Automated multi-agent review (2 Claude + 2 Codex + synthesis). This is AI-generated — please verify findings manually.*

---

## Critical Issues (must fix)

- **`NameError` at import — `Sequence` never imported** (`loop_ir_epilogue_lowering.py`). `_unique_reductions` annotates `values: Sequence[...]` but the module has no `from collections.abc import Sequence` and no `from __future__ import annotations`, so the annotation is evaluated eagerly at definition time and the module fails to import. This breaks `NVUniversalGemmScheduling` import and errors every new test at collection — meaning the tests were not actually run green. Fix: add `from collections.abc import Sequence` (matches sibling `loop_ir_cutedsl_codegen.py`). *(Claude Bug)*

- **`grouped_reduction_ir` drops surrounding arithmetic** (`loop_ir_epilogue_lowering.py:443-455`). It searches the whole expression tree and accepts a single nested reduction without verifying the reduction is the store root. `store(sum(load("gemm")) + 1.0)` is classified as `("sum", "identity")`, and the plan replaces the whole store with the raw sum, silently dropping `+ 1.0` → wrong output. Fix: after unwrapping only supported conversions/identities, require the store root itself to be the reduction; otherwise treat the surrounding arithmetic as a finalizer or reject the conversion. *(Codex Bug)*

- **Dense variants feed a CuteDSL function to CUTLASS `EpilogueArguments`** (`nv_universal_gemm_scheduling.py:790-821`). `LoopIRCuteDSLCodegen` is used for every NVGEMM variant, but dense FP16/BF16 GEMMs still pass the generated function to CUTLASS, which expects an EVT-compatible function. A fused supported epilogue like `torch.relu(a @ b)` lowers successfully and then fails at compile time. Fix: restrict this lowering path to `SCALED_GEMM` (fall back to `CutlassEVTCodegen` for dense), or give dense variants a real CuteDSL epilogue-argument implementation. *(Codex Bug)*

- **`_walk` no longer covers the full IR** (`loop_ir_epilogue_lowering.py:340`). Traversal iterates only positional `args`, but keyword operands are now stored in `kwargs`. Every analysis built on `_walk` can miss loads, reductions, and ops. Fix: add one canonical child iterator that covers both `args` and `kwargs`. *(Codex Design)*

- **Lossy fusion boundary** (`nv_universal_gemm_scheduling.py:793`). `evt_nodes` is filtered to `ComputedBuffer` objects while the scheduler still treats every node as fused, so unsupported node types can be silently omitted yet marked consumed. Make lowering all-or-nothing: reject the lossy conversion and fall back for the entire epilogue. *(Codex Design)*

## Important Suggestions (should fix)

- **Exception-driven backend selection is fragile** (`nv_universal_gemm_scheduling.py:799`). *(Consensus: Claude Design + Codex Design — higher confidence.)* Using a bare `except NotImplementedError` to choose between `LoopIRCuteDSLCodegen` and `CutlassEVTCodegen` conflates "epilogue unsupported" with genuine bugs raised deep in op-override lowering, silently masking regressions. Two parts:
  - Separate capability from execution: use an explicit `can_lower(...)`/`supports(...)` predicate or a dedicated unsupported-IR result/`Optional` return rather than catching a generic exception.
  - Add observability: this inserts an experimental path in front of a working one with zero telemetry. Log/counter the fallback and its reason (per the tlparse/structured-trace guidance) so path selection is diagnosable in production.

- **Two sources of truth for `loads`/`reductions`** (`loop_ir_epilogue_lowering.py:17`). *(Consensus: Claude Design + Codex Design.)* The dataclass caches `loads`/`reductions` while call sites defensively fall back to tree-walkers (`store.value.loads or _loaded_names(...)`, `store.value.reductions or _synthetic_reductions_ir(...)`). The cached metadata and walkers can drift, and `or` conflates "legitimately empty" with "not populated." Pick one authority: der [truncated]
